text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hey, Rui-chan's horns are cool, like stag beetles!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねーねー
ルイちゃんの角、
クワガタみたいでかっこいいね！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the compliment that didn't make me happy at all... Wait, hyaaah!!? D-Don't use your horns! You're making me shudder, so stop it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
全然うれしくない褒め言葉をありがとう……
って、
ひゃあぁっ！！？　
つ、
角はだめ！
ゾワゾワってしちゃうからやめて～っ！？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on, it's fine~♪ It's okay~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほれほれ、
よいではないか～♪
よいではないか～♪

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Wh-Where did you learn this shameless girl...?! Now that it's come to this... Alchemy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どこで覚えてきたのよこの破廉恥娘……っ！
こうなったら……
錬金術よ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: All right, I've finished the medicine that makes your weaknesses disappear!! Now you can hold my horns as long as you want!! Serves you right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よしっ、
『弱点が消える薬』完成っ！！
これで角はいくら握られても平気よ！！
ざまあみなさい！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～
反応悪ーい、
つまんなーい。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, maybe I'll grab her tail next.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……じゃあ次、
しっぽ握ってみようかな。
